title: PATCH /sites/{id} – request
description: Change the given properties of a site. Supervisor token, or the site phone's device token with an X-Acting-User header (then only on the phone's site). Requires an Idempotency-Key header. Response: 200, api/site.response.json.

no_data_alert_after_min.description: Minutes after the deadline of the last expected round without any data from the device before supervisors are alerted.
